summary: Split god module vdisplay_client by responsibility

delivery.outcome: Split src/koru/integrations/vdisplay_client.py (code2llm god module: 6546 lines, 272 top-level functions; gate is >40) into thirteen responsibility modules under src/koru/integrations/vdisplay/ plus a slim facade, moving every definition verbatim: source_policy (capture/source policy flags), vql_sidecar (sidecar observation, PNG resolution, capture meta interpretation and the refresh pipeline), imgl_loader (imgl/vdisplay CLI discovery, import machinery, subprocess env), ide_control (window focus and semantic IDE control orchestration), drive_prepare (photo-VQL drive preparation), chat_send (send_chat pipeline and selector plumbing with the _IDE_HINTS/_CHAT_INPUT_SELECTORS/_SUBMIT_BUTTON_SELECTORS constants), input_actuation (agent controls, keyboard submit, IDE-prompt and OS type-text), chat_target (photo-VQL chat target resolution), map_pointer (IDE-map capture/pointer target math), command_plan (VQL command plan, cursor validation, LLM coordinate resolution), capture_gates (capture-mismatch and unverified-chat gating), focus_edit (focus-and-edit pipeline and mouse move), vql_metadata (candidate/metadata loading, freshness policy and the optional-extra vdisplay.vql shims with their explanatory comment block). vdisplay_client.py keeps the runtime/availability wrappers, chat-text OCR verification, record_koru_drive_step and the vdisplay_fallback_enabled wrapper (10 defs) because they read the patchable _VDISPLAY_DIRECT facade state, and re-exports every moved name so `from koru.integrations.vdisplay_client import X` keeps working (the nxdo_discovery facade pattern from tickets 234/235). Behavior is preserved verbatim; the 62-name facade monkeypatch surface (audited across tests/ and packages/coru/tests/) keeps steering the pipeline because moved code resolves former module globals through a lazy `_vdc()` facade accessor at call time — patch targets route through the facade even when caller and callee share a new module, honoring the LOAD_GLOBAL/`__getattr__` regression record documented above the vdisplay.vql shims.
nonGoals: Changing any drive/fallback/gating behavior, log text, or default flags
Renaming or re-signing any public or private function
Touching any consumer (src/koru/agent_backend_runtime.py, src/koru/autopilot/*, src/koru/autonomy/cycle/cycle_gate.py, src/koru/integrations/photo_vql_*.py, packages/coru/*, packages/koruide/src/*)

Modifying the existing vdisplay test files or the vdisplay_readiness/desktop_probe/portal_input/window_focus/pointer_calibration/drive_result/env_session/surface_capture/control_policy/photo_vql_meta modules
Splitting or refactoring any other module flagged by code2llm

architecture.decision: Move definitions verbatim (same names, bodies text-preserved by a line-exact splitter) into thirteen responsibility modules and re-export them from the koru.integrations.vdisplay_client facade (the nxdo_discovery pattern). A patch audit across tests/ and packages/coru/tests/ found 62 distinct facade-level monkeypatch targets (including re-exported aliases like _dry_run, llm_vision_enabled, _vql_candidates_polluted and the vdisplay.vql shims). Because moved callers no longer share the facade's globals, every reference that was a vdisplay_client module global resolves through a module-local lazy accessor `def _vdc(): import koru.integrations.vdisplay_client as m; return m` as `_vdc().NAME`; names that tests patch route through the facade even when caller and callee land in the same module. Facade-resident functions keep plain global lookups, which preserves patchability without indirection. No module-level `__getattr__` is introduced (regression class documented in the file tail). The facade `__all__` is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit to restore the single 6546-line src/koru/integrations/vdisplay_client.py.

validation.evidence: vdisplay_client.py drops from 272 top-level defs to 10 and from 6546 to ~1170 lines; each responsibility module holds <=29 defs, under the code2llm god-module gate of 40.
